owner_calls.question: The name 'Ronin' is staged at Avengers: Endgame (row and recap cx-hawkeye:4 'he becomes Ronin'), but nobody says the name on screen until Hawkeye episode 1. Endgame only shows the persona. Keep it at Endgame or move the name to Hawkeye?
options: Keep at Endgame (the persona is on screen there)
Move 'Ronin' to the Hawkeye stage and reword cx-hawkeye:4 without the name (e.g. 'he becomes a masked vigilante')
owner_calls.evidence: MCU wiki lists the codename Ronin with its first reference in Hawkeye 1x01 (HE101). Hawkeye is cited only by his own name in the Endgame article; 'Ronin' shows up there only in a trailer citation title.
